name: eMACS J2137.2-2232 (Hubble)
blurb: eMACS J2137.2-2232, a massive, X-ray-luminous galaxy cluster, seen by Hubble.
label: emacsj213722232-hubble
story: A vast gathering of galaxies held together by gravity, among the most X-ray-luminous clusters of its era. Hubble took a snapshot of it in a hunt for the strongest cosmic lenses.

claims.text: eMACS J2137.2-2232 is a highly X-ray-luminous galaxy cluster from the extended Massive Cluster Survey
Target of a Hubble snapshot survey of the most massive clusters to find powerful lenses
Survey goal: identify the most powerful gravitational lenses at higher redshift
